# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.10

*Version code 68*

## What's New

**Bring your own TMDB and MDBList keys**
Content Services can now use keys saved securely on this device or synchronized through your
StreamDek account. Guided setup, validation, masked key details and clear storage choices make it
easy to improve artwork, metadata and ratings without exposing a device-only key to other devices.

**Smarter playback recovery**
When an on-demand source repeatedly buffers, StreamDek can offer the next ranked source while
preserving your position. Playback now also integrates with Android media controls and audio focus,
pauses when headphones disconnect, and handles source changes without stale callbacks taking over.

**Encrypted DNS controls**
New DNS-over-HTTPS settings let you choose a supported resolver or provide a custom endpoint for
media and add-on requests.

**Independent auto-skip controls**
Choose whether StreamDek automatically skips detected intros, recaps and endings. Each option is
independent and off by default, only acts on a valid skip marker, and shows a brief confirmation
when a segment is skipped.

## Improvements

**Continue Watching is clearer across devices**
When a movie or series was started on another device and needs a local source, StreamDek now says
exactly what happened, identifies the saved episode when available, and keeps the dismissible notice
visible long enough to read. Direct resumes no longer wait for unrelated watched-history sync work.

**Larger add-on catalogs open in full**
Home keeps a concise preview while **View All** opens the complete catalog response, including
providers that do not implement offset paging. TMDB ratings are resolved only for visible preview
cards to avoid unnecessary requests.

**Safer peer-to-peer episode selection**
Season packs now select the requested episode by filename and episode identity. StreamDek refuses
to substitute a different episode merely because it is the largest video in the torrent.

**Content-service reminders are easier to read**
The missing-ratings reminder now uses an opaque themed surface with stronger contrast. Setup
deferrals are respected, and closing incomplete setup no longer causes it to reappear immediately.

**A more resilient Home hero**
The hero now gathers suitable movie and series suggestions independently from the visible Home
rows, so it remains populated when Trending is hidden or a provider uses different catalog
categories. Streaming Networks and Live TV content are excluded from hero selection.

**Clearer watched controls on series episodes**
The Episode Streams action now reads **Mark Previous Episodes Watched**, and watched-status controls
sit directly below and align with the episode title for easier scanning.

**Home content appears sooner**
Home now shows the built-in rows as soon as they are ready instead of waiting for every add-on
catalogue to answer, so one slow add-on no longer holds up the whole screen. Home also no longer
reloads itself several times over while the app is starting.

**A smoother player**
The player screen has been split into smaller pieces so Android can compile it ahead of use rather
than interpreting it. Opening the subtitle, audio and source panels drops noticeably fewer frames.

**More streaming sources search at the same time**
Source plugins now run on a thread pool intended for network work, so more of them genuinely search
in parallel instead of queueing behind one another.

**Home rows are grouped by where they come from**
The Home rows list now folds into one section per source — StreamDek's own rows, and each add-on —
so a long list is quick to scan. A source whose rows cannot currently appear is greyed and says
why: either StreamDek Home Rows is switched off, or the add-on itself is. Your individual row
choices are kept exactly as they were and come back when the source is switched on again.

**StreamDek Home Rows now covers every StreamDek row**
Recommended For You, Trending On Trakt and Watchlist follow the StreamDek Home Rows switch
alongside the catalogue rows, and each can also be switched on or off on its own. Continue
Watching, New Episodes, your live favourites and your own playlists are not affected by it.

**Home rows keep the order you gave them**
Recommended For You, Trending On Trakt and Watchlist now appear wherever you placed them in the
Home rows list rather than always at the end.

**Rows from add-ons you have removed can be cleared**
Rows saved from add-ons that are no longer installed are gathered under a single entry with a
Remove action, so they can be cleared in one step rather than one at a time.

## Fixed

* Fixed Continue Watching cards becoming unresponsive after one tap or while an unrelated stream
  request was still marked as loading.
* Fixed failed or empty season metadata leaving Continue Watching permanently stuck until the app
  restarted.
* Fixed stale playback callbacks opening or resuming the wrong movie or episode.
* Fixed cross-device resume positions being applied before the exact media was ready.
* Fixed removing a Continue Watching title under one provider identity allowing the same title to
  return under another equivalent identity.
* Fixed different episodes of the same series being merged into one Continue Watching card.
* Fixed add-on catalogs that return their complete list on every request appearing limited to the
  first 20 items.
* Fixed audio continuing after headphones or another private audio route disconnected.
